title: Messiah Born of a Virgin
content: The Old Testament prophet Isaiah foretold that the Messiah would be born of a virgin. This prophecy emphasized the miraculous nature of the Messiah's arrival. The New Testament records that Jesus was conceived by the Holy Spirit and born to the virgin Mary, fulfilling Isaiah's prophecy and demonstrating that His birth was a direct act of God.

title: Messiah Born in Bethlehem
content: The prophet Micah predicted that the Messiah would be born in Bethlehem, a small town in Judah. This prophecy was written centuries before the birth of Jesus. The Gospels record that Jesus was born in Bethlehem during the reign of Herod, fulfilling Micah's prediction and identifying Jesus as the promised Messiah.

title: The Suffering Servant Prophecy
content: Isaiah 53 describes a servant of God who would suffer on behalf of others, bearing their sins and being wounded for their transgressions. Christians understand this passage as a prophetic description of the suffering and death of Jesus Christ. The New Testament explains that Jesus fulfilled this prophecy by dying on the cross as a sacrifice for sin.
